roles.maker: produces the candidate (including AutoResearcher output); untrusted until the ceremony ends; never approves or self-verifies
roles.evaluator: fixed, versioned check; not editable by the maker during the experiment
roles.operator: only role that approves digests, accepts evidence, merges, promotes and activates

stages.name: claim
stages.gate: one owner on the board; others do not push

stages.name: candidate
stages.gate: immutable exact SHAs; consumer is the exact merging head

stages.name: scope-record
stages.gate: states scope; status and capability flags are labels, not enforcement; pins in the package file take effect at merge

stages.name: history-preserved
stages.gate: prior generation archived byte for byte and tested against independent frozen identities

stages.name: checks-can-fail
stages.gate: mutation test refuses a self-consistent wrong input; red before green

stages.name: verify-matrix
stages.gate: all supported interpreters, drift guard, lint baseline, CI at exact head

stages.name: batch-review
stages.gate: one request, all exact heads, fixed return format

stages.name: freeze-proposal
stages.gate: digests at exact head; operator script rehearsed without writes

stages.name: operator-approval
stages.gate: operator-run; approval binds consumer, harness, manifest, coverage and allowlist digests

stages.name: hosted-evidence
stages.gate: dispatch only from a verified approval; per-file sealed digests

stages.name: independent-recompute
stages.gate: non-maker recompute from raw artifacts; maker recompute labelled not independent

stages.name: acceptance-and-receipt
stages.gate: operator accepts; metadata-only receipt with independence table and claim limits

stages.name: merge
stages.gate: for pins this is the activation; merge commits pinned to approved head; stacked base retargeted first; labels updated to match

stages.name: rollback-record
stages.gate: previous generation is the rollback target; rollback is a new reviewed generation

stages.name: graduate-to-memory
stages.gate: after canonical evidence only; additive; lessons via the capture tool

never: alter the acceptance metric during an experiment
edit the evaluator, safety policy or acceptance tests, even between experiments
mutate production topology from natural language

virtual_versioning.model: generation = immutable named contract; ACTIVE pointer; consumers declare generation or edge; analogy: browser compatibility modes
limits: pins decide fresh installs, not running environments
frozen manifests keep original labels; live record supersedes
capabilities are separate switches in still_off
policy: undeclared production, CI and installer consumers refuse
retired is forbidden while active or declared
rollback is a reviewed pointer-transition receipt, not a state
